chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abd al-Wahhab ibn al-Subah said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The obligatory period for breastfeeding is twenty-one months; whatever is less than twenty-one months means the infant has not completed breastfeeding, and if one wishes to complete the breastfeeding, [it is] two full years.'
ai.seo_question: What is the obligatory duration of breastfeeding according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the juristic consensus that the legal threshold for establishing kinship through breastfeeding (radāʿ) is twenty-one months, distinguishing it from the biological recommendation of two full years. It highlights the Shia scholarly distinction between the obligatory period for mahram status and the complete natural duration, reflecting the precision of fiqh in family law.
